# Duetkifu

> Duetkifu is an open-source research record that a researcher and an AI agent keep together: every move of a research (each attempt, correction, independent audit, conclusion and planned option), dead ends included, with the move it follows, why it was made, what came of it and, for a failure, why it ended, with a cause that tells a wrong idea from data that cannot be trusted. Every number says where it comes from: recomputed from the raw files by recorded scripts (with checks of each stated number against the recomputation), sourced from named files with SHA-256 fingerprints, or no data with a reason. The record (kifu.json, format duetkifu/0.1) is drawn as a tree the user reads and edits in one HTML page; the agent writes the text, and the page marks what the agent wrote until the user has looked at it. It includes Duetsheet, the interactive report reviewed with an agent (report.json, format duetsheet/0.7).

Version 0.8. Start it from Claude Code with the /duetkifu skill (install: `/plugin marketplace add Ashur5457/duetkifu`, then `/plugin install duetkifu@duetkifu`), or run `python duetkifu.py <data folder>` (Python standard library only): the page opens in the browser already connected to the folder, and both files are stored in its duetkifu/ subfolder (an existing duetsheet/ subfolder is opened as it is) while raw data is only read. `python duetkifu.py check <folder>` validates both files and the data chain; `kifu check|tree|show` work on the record; `find <folder> "words"` searches every file of a large folder through a local SQLite full-text index, so agents read excerpts instead of whole reports; `extract <folder> <report.html|slides.pptx>` pulls out figures and tables; `annotations`, `wait` and `agent-status` let an agent answer the page's "Ask the agent to revise" button. Comments can point at a report block, a data range on a chart, or one move of the record (tags such as fill-in-this-move and recompute-this). Interface in English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Spanish.

Use Duetkifu when research is done with AI agents and the whole path must be kept and checkable: what was tried, what failed and why, and where each number comes from. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor or any agent that can edit JSON files.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what it is, why, features, quick start, FAQ, limitations, roadmap
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): both formats, how to write them safely, and agent tasks (keep the record as you work, handle comments on a move, find things in a large folder, revise the report, import data)
- [Tutorial](docs/tutorial.md): step by step with screenshots
- [Record schema](schema/kifu.schema.json) and [report schema](schema/report.schema.json)
- [Translating](docs/translating.md): interface translations

## Files

- [duetkifu.html](duetkifu.html): the page (single self-contained file)
- [duetkifu.py](duetkifu.py): launcher, checker, search index and agent helpers
- [skills/duetkifu/SKILL.md](skills/duetkifu/SKILL.md): the /duetkifu skill for Claude Code
- [Example project](examples/demo-project/): a report, a record of 25 moves over six cycles, raw data, derived tables and the scripts that make them (synthetic data)
- [tests/](tests/): tests of the launcher, the record and the agent loop
- [tools/check.py](tools/check.py): checks translations, English-only code and JavaScript syntax
